failureClassification.classification: portal branch test-fixture startup-fence defect; fixed, final logger/core gates required
failureClassification.completion: Explicitly stopped with SIGTERM after the reported failure for diagnosis; this incomplete run is not qualification.
failureClassification.detail: thread-stream 4.0.0 flush() acknowledges only the shared buffer and may return before queued main-thread startup writes. This allowed a pre-arm startup write to run after fault arming and collide with the live fault probe, exposing vendor nextFlush offset -2. The retained control deterministically observes zero processed startup writes after flush(), one after flushSync(). The fixture now flushSyncs only while healthy, drains the scheduled empty flush with setImmediate, and asserts a real worker-side healthy-write counter before arm. All asynchronous post-arm fault injections, live survival/redaction/drop assertions and original timeouts remain unchanged; no production logger or dependency version changes.
failureClassification.finalResult: Deterministic startup control passed; complete logger 134/0 and normal unfiltered core 25286/0/103 passed naturally after the two-fixture startup-fence correction. Production packages unchanged.
